label: Sequential control: pacing, throttling and limits under delay and shocks
summary: Open-loop schedule against a PID pacer with anti-windup over 288 five-minute steps with outages, surges and delayed feedback; reports tracking error, overshoot, under-delivery and control-effort noise.
traps: An outage and a surge inside the day
A hard cap where overshoot is worse than undershoot
Gains high enough to make the controller jitter

slots.meaning: what has been delivered so far, seen after a delay
the demand available each step, which the controller does not control
